review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: M1 tide pool floor: a bowl under the swim plane with sand, silt patches and a grey stone rim lip in vertex colour, sand ripples in a CC0 normal map, and a shelf out past the edge of the camera view.

dependencies.use: sand-ripple normal map in M_PoolFloor.tres (assets/export/T_PoolFloor_Normal.png), tiled every 5 m

textures.name: T_PoolFloor_Normal
textures.packing: tangent-space normal (OpenGL, +Y up), on M_PoolFloor.tres with uv1_scale 26.4

pivot: pool centre on the swim plane (Godot y = 0)

vertex_colors.encoding: sRGB-encoded in COLOR_0; the engine material sets vertex_color_is_srgb (assets/export/M_PoolFloor.tres)
vertex_colors.note: Sand with soft silt patches and a silty centre, and a grey stone band on the rim lip, blended per vertex.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; vertex colours carried over

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_m1_production.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders; the floor's own material is assets/export/M_PoolFloor.tres, with a normal map from the CC0 Poly Haven scan in dependencies.
